name: @wizeworks/studio
description: The editing engine behind Piggles' theme / layout / page / component / email builders. Holds documents in memory as the STORE shapes them — a theme, a layout and a page are three documents with three lifecycles, not one site blob — applies semantic ops with their own inverses for per-document undo, and resolves the theme -> layout -> page chain for a canvas. Framework-neutral at the root; the pane-ready React builders live at ./react. Reuses @wizeworks/silicaui-html for the node schema, the projection and the theme math, and never forks it.
